WRITEshort answers, 1-10 in your notebookFriday Fact Check 1: chapters 1-7
  1. What is the most important rule at Camp Green Lake? "Don't upset the Warden."
  2. Why does X-Ray take the shortest shovel? shorter shovel = smaller hole = less digging
  3. What does Stanley's family call Elya? "no-good-dirty-rotten-pig-stealing-great-great-grandfather"
  4. Who robbed Stanley's great-grandfather? Kissin' Kate Barlow
  5. Whose shoes was Stanley accused of stealing? Clyde "Sweet Feet" Livingston's
  1. What does Mr Sir eat, and why? sunflower seeds: he quit smoking
  2. What do the boys call Mr Pendanski? Mom
  3. What did Elya promise Madame Zeroni? (3 things) carry her up the mountain, let her drink, sing to her
  4. Why did Madame Zeroni curse Elya? he broke his promise
  5. What is Stanley's father trying to invent? a way to recycle old sneakers
  Tick what you got right. Correct the rest in a different colour.Your corrections = your revision list.

Chapter 8 is about 200 words. Listen to the first two sentences carefully: lizards and curses.
SAY ITTHEN WRITELizard fact file + Symbol Tracker

STEP 1: SAY IT Fill the gaps out loud

Number of spots: exactly 11
Eyes: yellow, with red skin around them
Teeth and tongue: black teeth, milky white tongue
Lives in: holes (up to 20 in one hole)
Eats: small animals, insects, cactus thorns and sunflower seed shells
If it bites you: "a slow and painful death"

Think: in chapter 7, Mr Sir spat his sunflower seed shells into Stanley's hole. Why is that worrying?

STEP 2: WRITE 2 new rows in your Symbol Tracker

SymbolChWhat it shows
Yellow-spotted lizards1, 8a symbol of ___ . They live in the ___ the boys dig.
Sunflower seeds7, 8the shells ___ the lizards, so they mean ___ .
Lizards: a symbol of danger and death. They live in the holes the boys dig.
Sunflower seeds: the shells attract the lizards, so they mean danger.
The test lists both of these as symbols. Keep adding to them!

WRITEfull sentences in your notebookSet A: chapter 9
A1What is Stanley's new nickname? How does he get it?
His nickname is ___. The boys call him that after ___ .
"The Lump wasn't the Caveman. He was."
His nickname is Caveman. The boys call him that after he talks back to the Lump in the Wreck Room, so they think he's tough.
A2Why does Stanley lie in his letter to his mother?
He lies because he doesn't want ...
He lies because he doesn't want his mother to worry about him.
A3Find one lie in the letter. What is the truth?
He writes that ___. The truth is ___ .
Can you swim or water-ski on Green Lake?
He writes that he will learn to water-ski after a swimming test. The truth is there is no water in the lake: he spends all day digging holes.
A4Zero asks if the shoes had red X's on the back. Why is this strange?
It is strange because Zero ... This makes me think ...
It is strange because Zero was not there when the shoes fell. This makes me think Zero may have seen the shoes before. It's a clue to remember!
Extension (early finishers): add "Caveman" to Stanley's box in your Tent D gallery.

SAY ITTHEN WRITEDig deeper: the water line

"They always lined up in the same order... no matter who got there first."

1 X-Ray2 Armpit3 Squid4 Zigzag5 Magnet6 Zero7 Stanley

STEP 1: SAY IT

  • Who is always first? Who is last?
  • Does it matter who arrives first?
  • New word: a hierarchy = a ranking, from most to least important.

STEP 2: WRITE

The boys always line up in the same order because it shows a ___ . X-Ray is first because ___ . New boys like Stanley go ___ .
The boys always line up in the same order because it shows a hierarchy. X-Ray is first because he is the leader of Group D. New boys like Stanley go at the back, behind Zero.
This is a real test-style question. The key word is hierarchy.
WRITEfull sentences in your notebookSet B: chapter 10
B1Why does Stanley think the fossil is his "miracle"?
He thinks it is a miracle because Mr Sir and Mr Pendanski said that ...
He thinks it is a miracle because Mr Sir and Mr Pendanski said that if the Warden likes what you find, you get the rest of the day off.
B2Why doesn't Stanley get the day off?
He doesn't get the day off because Mr Pendanski says "___".
He doesn't get the day off because Mr Pendanski says "The Warden isn't interested in fossils."
B3Stretch: if the Warden isn't interested in fossils, what is the Warden looking for? Give your theory.
I think the Warden is looking for ___ because ...
Think about Kissin' Kate Barlow: she robbed people.
I think the Warden is looking for something valuable, like treasure, because the boys only get a day off for finding something the Warden likes, and a fossil is not good enough.
Keep your theory: we'll find out if you're right!
